abstract: Anti-immigration policies often rest on the premise that immigrants worsen native-born employment and wages. This column uses data from 2000 to 2023 to estimate the impact of immigration to the US on national wages and employment, focusing on national rather than local impacts. The authors find that in these two decades, net immigration to the US was heavily college-intensive and raised the wages of less-educated natives. It also increased natives’ employment. Natives’ reallocation into higher-paying, communication-intensive occupations, complementary to those filled by immigrants, is one mechanism behind these gains.
abstract_zh: 反移民政策往往基于一个前提，即移民会恶化本土出生者的就业和工资状况。本文利用2000年至2023年的数据，评估了美国移民对全国工资和就业的影响，重点关注全国层面而非地方层面的效应。作者发现，在这二十年里，美国净移民高度集中于受过大学教育的人群，并提升了教育程度较低的本土出生者的工资水平。同时，移民也增加了本土出生者的就业机会。本土出生者向薪酬更高、沟通密集型职业的重新配置，与移民所从事的职业形成互补，是这些收益背后的机制之一。
title: Revisiting immigration’s effect on US wages and employment
title_zh: 重新审视移民对美国工资与就业的影响

abstract: Macroprudential policy is designed to make the financial system safer, but it can also reshape the finance available to innovative firms. Using patent data matched to 2,844 firms in 21 European countries over 1990-2021, this column finds that macroprudential tightening is followed by lower patenting and lower patent quality. The effect is strongest when credit growth is weak and among financially constrained firms, and it is concentrated in instruments that directly restrict credit. By contrast, financial-resilience tools carry no measurable short-run innovation cost and may support innovation over longer horizons. The findings suggest that policymakers can protect financial stability without systematically penalising innovation, provided they are selective about which instruments they deploy.
abstract_zh: 宏观审慎政策旨在提升金融体系的安全性，但同时也可能重塑创新型企业可获得的融资环境。本文利用1990年至2021年间覆盖21个欧洲国家2844家企业的专利数据，发现宏观审慎政策的收紧伴随着专利申请数量及专利质量的下降。这一效应在信贷增长疲软时期及面临融资约束的企业中尤为显著，且主要集中在直接限制信贷的工具上。相比之下，金融韧性工具在短期内未带来可测的创新成本，并可能在更长时期内支持创新活动。研究结果表明，政策制定者能够在保障金融稳定的同时，避免系统性抑制创新，前提是审慎选择所采用的工具类型。
authors: Xuan Viet Ho, Brigitte Granville, Luu Duc Toan Huynh, Steven Ongena
title: Macroprudential policy may curb innovation – but instrument choice matters
title_zh: 宏观审慎政策可能抑制创新——但工具选择至关重要

abstract: This paper investigates the conditions under which mergers between corporate social responsibility (CSR) firms are both privately profitable and socially desirable. We develop a Cournot model of quantity competition with product differentiation, featuring both CSR and non-CSR firms. CSR firms engage in observable CSR investment, which affects consumer willingness to pay depending on the level of CSR cognition in the market. We analyse a two-stage game in which CSR firms decide whether to propose a merger and a (myopic) Antitrust Authority (AA) determines whether to authorise it. Our results show that the profitability and approval of such mergers crucially depend on the degree of product differentiation and consumer sensitivity to CSR. When products are sufficiently complementary (or weakly substitutable) and CSR awareness is high, the merger increases both firm profits and consumer surplus, leading to regulatory approval. However, when the merger induces the exit of non-CSR competitors and products are homogeneous, a divergence emerges between private and social incentives, with the AA often blocking otherwise profitable mergers. These findings provide novel insights into merger policy design in settings where ethical competition and market power coexist.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业社会责任（CSR）企业之间的合并既具有私人盈利性又具有社会合意性的条件。我们构建了一个包含产品差异化的数量竞争古诺模型，其中同时包含CSR企业与非CSR企业。CSR企业进行可观察的CSR投资，该投资根据市场中CSR认知水平影响消费者的支付意愿。我们分析了一个两阶段博弈，其中CSR企业决定是否提议合并，而（短视的）反垄断机构（AA）决定是否批准该合并。我们的结果表明，此类合并的盈利性与批准与否关键取决于产品差异化程度和消费者对CSR的敏感度。当产品充分互补（或弱替代）且CSR意识较高时，合并既增加企业利润又提升消费者剩余，从而获得监管批准。然而，当合并导致非CSR竞争对手退出且产品同质时，私人激励与社会激励之间出现分歧，反垄断机构往往阻止原本有利可图的合并。这些发现为在伦理竞争与市场力量并存的背景下设计合并政策提供了新颖见解。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Strategic corporate social responsibility and merger decisions
title_zh: 战略性企业社会责任与并购决策
